direct_measurement_rule: calibrated confidence, image evidence, residual and support all satisfy the typed tolerance policy
clamped_measurement_rule: model hypothesis is accepted only after positive_negative evidence sampling or classical geometry verification
predictive_rule: retain hypothesis and uncertainty when geometry is plausible but measurement evidence is insufficient
undeterminable_rule: return no measurement when neither model nor image evidence satisfies minimum admissibility
forbidden: report predictive hypothesis as measurement PASS
replace missing evidence with another case asset
